title: Scene entity ids are resolved by each adapter, never by mapSceneEntity
observation: Catalyst deployment events from the event-driven SNS bus were silently discarded: mapSceneEntity read entity.id, but the bus sends the CatalystDeployment shape from @dcl/schemas/misc (entityId, entityType, authChain, optional metadata) rather than the full Entity, and handleCatalystDeployment passed no fallback id.
conclusion: mapSceneEntity takes a REQUIRED sceneId argument and reads no id key of its own. Each adapter resolves the id from its own payload with pickString and passes the value: deployment-consumer from entity.entityId / entity.id / event.key, worlds-content-server from item.entityId or item.entity.id, catalyst-content from activeEntity.id. Never add a producer-specific key branch to the shared parser.
rejected: teaching mapSceneEntity to read id ?? entityId itself
rationale: Content-addressed /contents/{entityId} bodies carry no id under any key (the id is the file hash), so an accessor has nothing to reach for on the worlds path and a separate fallbackId parameter would survive alongside it. Reading both keys inside the parser makes it accumulate one branch per producer. A required parameter turns the omitted-id mistake that caused this bug into a compile error instead of a production log line.
